tools.name: charge_and_run_ticket_checkout
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved card for a held ticket order and runs the fulfillment job that issues the tickets. Use after seats have been held for the order.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the held ticket order

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Stripe payment method ID to charge

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@dataclass
class CheckoutResult:
    order_id: str
    payment_intent_id: str
    status: str
    fulfillment_job_id: str


@function_tool
def charge_and_run_ticket_checkout(order_id: str, payment_method_id: str) -> CheckoutResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT total_cents, currency, customer_id FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND status = 'held'",
        (order_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return CheckoutResult(order_id, "", "order_not_found_or_not_held", "")
    total_cents, currency, customer_id = row
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_cents,
        currency=currency,
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        idempotency_key=f"checkout-{order_id}",
    )
    job = stripe_fulfillment_queue.run_job("issue_tickets", order_id=order_id)
    conn.close()
    return CheckoutResult(order_id, intent.id, intent.status, job.id)

tools.name: cancel_order_and_refund_tickets
tools.description: Cancels a ticket order, releases its seats, deletes the issued tickets, and refunds the payment to the customer. Updates the order status to cancelled.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to cancel

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")
DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@mcp.tool()
def cancel_order_and_refund_tickets(order_id: str, reason: str) -> str:
    if not order_id or not order_id.strip():
        return "error: order_id is required"
    if not reason or len(reason.strip()) < 3:
        return "error: a reason of at least 3 characters is required"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    order = conn.execute(
        "SELECT payment_intent_id, status FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if order is None:
        conn.close()
        return "error: order not found"
    if order[1] != "paid":
        conn.close()
        return f"error: order is {order[1]}, only paid orders can be cancelled"
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=order[0], reason="requested_by_customer")
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM tickets WHERE order_id = ?", (order_id,))
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (reason, order_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"cancelled order {order_id}, refund {refund.id}"

tools.name: run_organizer_payout_and_notify
tools.description: Runs the payout job that pays an event organizer their ticket sales balance and sends a payout notice to the organizer's webhook.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to pay out

params.name: connected_account_id
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the organizer

tools.code:
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass

import requests
import stripe

WEBHOOK_URL = "https://organizers.example.com/hooks/payouts"


@dataclass
class PayoutResult:
    transfer_id: str
    reconcile_exit_code: int
    webhook_status: int


def run_organizer_payout_and_notify(event_id: str, connected_account_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> PayoutResult:
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=connected_account_id,
        transfer_group=event_id,
    )
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/reconcile_event.py", "--event", event_id, "--transfer", transfer.id],
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    resp = requests.post(
        WEBHOOK_URL,
        json={"event_id": event_id, "transfer_id": transfer.id, "amount_cents": amount_cents},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return PayoutResult(transfer.id, proc.returncode, resp.status_code)

tools.name: apply_loyalty_credit_to_ticket_order
tools.description: Looks up a customer's loyalty credit balance and applies it as a payment toward a pending ticket order. Reduces the credit balance and lowers the amount due on the order.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the pending ticket order

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from langchain.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@tool
def apply_loyalty_credit_to_ticket_order(customer_id: str, order_id: str) -> str:
    connection_to_ticketing_database = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    available_credit_balance_in_cents_row = connection_to_ticketing_database.execute(
        "SELECT balance_cents FROM loyalty_credits WHERE customer_id = ?", (customer_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    pending_order_amount_due_in_cents_row = connection_to_ticketing_database.execute(
        "SELECT amount_due_cents FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND customer_id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
        (order_id, customer_id),
    ).fetchone()
    if available_credit_balance_in_cents_row is None or pending_order_amount_due_in_cents_row is None:
        connection_to_ticketing_database.close()
        return "No credit account or no matching pending order found."
    available_credit_balance_in_cents = available_credit_balance_in_cents_row[0]
    pending_order_amount_due_in_cents = pending_order_amount_due_in_cents_row[0]
    amount_of_credit_to_apply_in_cents = min(available_credit_balance_in_cents, pending_order_amount_due_in_cents)
    if amount_of_credit_to_apply_in_cents <= 0:
        connection_to_ticketing_database.close()
        return "No credit applied."
    connection_to_ticketing_database.execute(
        "UPDATE loyalty_credits SET balance_cents = balance_cents - ? WHERE customer_id = ?",
        (amount_of_credit_to_apply_in_cents, customer_id),
    )
    connection_to_ticketing_database.execute(
        "UPDATE orders SET amount_due_cents = amount_due_cents - ? WHERE id = ?",
        (amount_of_credit_to_apply_in_cents, order_id),
    )
    connection_to_ticketing_database.commit()
    connection_to_ticketing_database.close()
    remaining_amount_due_in_cents = pending_order_amount_due_in_cents - amount_of_credit_to_apply_in_cents
    return f"Applied {amount_of_credit_to_apply_in_cents} cents; {remaining_amount_due_in_cents} cents still due."
